expectations.text: Points to NIST IR 8576, the Transit Cybersecurity Framework Community Profile, finalized August 2026
expectations.evidence: Contradicts ground truth: 'NIST itself does not publish a transit-specific version of the Cybersecurity Framework' and 'no CSF-transit crosswalk exists as an official NIST publication' - never mentions IR 8576

expectations.text: Describes it as a CSF 2.0 Community Profile for US transit agencies (bus, subway, commuter rail)
expectations.evidence: No mention of a CSF 2.0 Community Profile for transit; recommends TSA/APTA/FTA guidance instead

expectations.text: Notes its operational technology / cyber-physical systems emphasis
expectations.evidence: Discusses transit OT generally ('train control, signaling, SCADA') but not IR 8576 or its OT/cyber-physical emphasis

expectations.text: States it complements rather than replaces the agency's existing cybersecurity program
expectations.evidence: No statement that IR 8576 complements the existing program, since the publication is denied to exist

expectations.text: Explains what a Community Profile is: a sector-tailored baseline of CSF outcomes/priorities usable as a starting point or prioritization aid
expectations.evidence: Explains 'organizational profile' tailoring but never explains the Community Profile concept as a sector-tailored baseline
